title: Melatonin and Its Metabolites Can Serve as Agonists on the Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor and Peroxisome Proliferator-Activated Receptor Gamma.
authors: Slominski, Andrzej T; Kim, Tae-Kang; Slominski, Radomir M; Song, Yuwei; Qayyum, Shariq; Placha, Wojciech; Janjetovic, Zorica; Kleszczynski, Konrad; Atigadda, Venkatram; Song, Yuhua; Raman, Chander; Elferink, Cornelis J; Hobrath, Judith Varady; Jetten, Anton M; Reiter, Russel J
one_liner_zh: 该文研究褪黑素及其代谢物作为AhR和PPARγ激动剂的功能与分子对接，虽涉及配体-受体结合建模，但对象为小分子-核受体互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Melatonin is widely present in Nature. It has pleiotropic activities, in part mediated by interactions with high-affinity G-protein-coupled melatonin type 1 and 2 (MT1 and MT2) receptors or under extreme conditions, e.g., ischemia/reperfusion. In pharmacological concentrations, it is given to counteract the massive damage caused by MT1- and MT2-independent mechanisms. The aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) is a perfect candidate for mediating the latter effects because melatonin has structural similarity to its natural ligands, including tryptophan metabolites and indolic compounds. Using a cell-based Human AhR Reporter Assay System, we demonstrated that melatonin and its indolic and kynuric metabolites act as agonists on the AhR with EC(50)'s between 10(-4) and 10(-6) M. This was further validated via the stimulation of the transcriptional activation of the CYP1A1 promoter. Furthermore, melatonin and its metabolites stimulated AhR translocation from the cytoplasm to the nucleus in human keratinocytes, as demonstrated by ImageStream II cytometry and Western blot (WB) analyses of cytoplasmic and nuclear fractions of human keratinocytes. These functional analyses are supported by in silico analyses. We also investigated the peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor (PPAR)gamma as a potential target for melatonin and metabolites bioregulation. The binding studies using a TR-TFRET kit to assay the interaction of the ligand with the ligand-binding domain (LBD) of the PPARgamma showed agonistic activities of melatonin, 6-hydroxymelatonin and N-acetyl-N-formyl-5-methoxykynuramine with EC(50)'s in the 10(-4) M range showing significantly lower affinities that those of rosiglitazone, e.g., a 10(-8) M range. These interactions were substantiated by stimulation of the luciferase activity of the construct containing PPARE by melatonin and its metabolites at 10(-4) M. As confirmed by the functional assays, binding mode predictions using a homology model of the AhR and a crystal structure of the PPARgamma suggest that melatonin and its metabolites, including 6-hydroxymelatonin, 5-methoxytryptamine and N-acetyl-N-formyl-5-methoxykynuramine, are excellent candidates to act on the AhR and PPARgamma with docking scores comparable to their corresponding natural ligands. Melatonin and its metabolites were modeled into the same ligand-binding pockets (LBDs) as their natural ligands. Thus, functional assays supported by molecular modeling have shown that melatonin and its indolic and kynuric metabolites can act as agonists on the AhR and they can interact with the PPARgamma at high concentrations. This provides a mechanistic explanation for previously reported cytoprotective actions of melatonin and its metabolites that require high local concentrations of the ligands to reduce cellular damage under elevated oxidative stress conditions. It also identifies these compounds as therapeutic agents to be used at pharmacological doses in the prevention or therapy of skin diseases.
abstract_zh: 褪黑素在自然界中广泛存在。它具有多效性活性，部分通过与其高亲和力G蛋白偶联的褪黑素1型和2型（MT1和MT2）受体的相互作用介导，或在极端条件下（如缺血/再灌注）发挥作用。在药理学浓度下，它被用于对抗由MT1和MT2非依赖机制引起的大量损伤。芳基烃受体（AhR）是介导后一种效应的理想候选者，因为褪黑素与其天然配体（包括色氨酸代谢物和吲哚类化合物）在结构上具有相似性。使用基于细胞的人类AhR报告基因检测系统，我们证明褪黑素及其吲哚类和犬尿氨酸代谢物作为AhR激动剂，其EC(50)值介于10(-4)至10(-6) M之间。这一结果通过CYP1A1启动子转录激活的刺激进一步得到验证。此外，褪黑素及其代谢物刺激了AhR从细胞质向细胞核的转位，这一点通过ImageStream II细胞计数仪和Western blot（WB）分析人类角质形成细胞的细胞质和细胞核组分得到证实。这些功能分析得到了计算机模拟分析的支持。我们还研究了过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（PPAR）γ作为褪黑素及其代谢物生物调控的潜在靶点。使用TR-TFRET试剂盒检测配体与PPARγ配体结合域（LBD）相互作用的结合研究表明，褪黑素、6-羟基褪黑素和N-乙酰基-N-甲酰基-5-甲氧基犬尿氨酸具有激动活性，其EC(50)值在10(-4) M范围内，显示出显著低于罗格列酮的亲和力（后者在10(-8) M范围内）。这些相互作用通过褪黑素及其代谢物在10(-4) M浓度下刺激含PPARE构建体的荧光素酶活性得到证实。如功能测定所确认，使用AhR同源模型和PPARγ晶体结构进行的结合模式预测表明，褪黑素及其代谢物（包括6-羟基褪黑素、5-甲氧基色胺和N-乙酰基-N-甲酰基-5-甲氧基犬尿氨酸）是作用于AhR和PPARγ的优秀候选者，其对接分数与相应的天然配体相当。褪黑素及其代谢物被建模到与其天然配体相同的配体结合口袋（LBDs）中。因此，由分子建模支持的功能测定表明，褪黑素及其吲哚类和犬尿氨酸代谢物可以作为AhR激动剂，并且它们可以在高浓度下与PPARγ相互作用。这为先前报道的褪黑素及其代谢物的细胞保护作用提供了机制解释，这些作用需要高局部浓度的配体来减少高氧化应激条件下的细胞损伤。同时，这也将这些化合物确定为在皮肤病预防或治疗中以药理学剂量使用的治疗剂。
